details: Architected a multi-tenant LLM and RAG inference platform supporting 20+ enterprise deployments and 1M+ daily requests, separating retrieval, orchestration, and model-serving services on Kubernetes to maintain 99.9% uptime

Designed LangGraph-based AI orchestration workflows integrating document analysis, retrieval, LLM inference, and response verification, with automated validation gates, retry mechanisms, and fault isolation across enterprise deployments

Spearheaded the migration of 12 legacy ML workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, containerizing services with Docker and managing cloud environments through Terraform; reduced infrastructure costs by 35% and deployment cycles from 10 days to 2 days

Orchestrated a cross-functional team of 6 engineers and 3 product owners to deliver a document-intelligence agent in 10 weeks, establishing evaluation criteria, milestone ownership, and phased production rollout procedures

Instituted automated model evaluation and drift-monitoring workflows using MLflow, Prometheus, and Grafana, integrating regression checks and monitoring alerts into CI/CD processes to detect model regressions 4x faster and reduce production incidents by 40%

Hardened embedding and vector-search infrastructure handling 50M+ documents through index sharding, response caching, and load-tested failover, maintaining p95 latency below 300 ms under 3x normal traffic
Mentored 4 junior engineers through weekly architecture reviews, production deployment walkthroughs, and code reviews, reducing their time to first production release from 8 weeks to 5

Optimized transformer-based semantic ranking models for enterprise search using hard-negative mining and embedding fine-tuning, improving offline top-3 relevance by 18% on NDCG and online click-through rates by 9%
Streamlined model development workflows through reusable Apache Airflow pipelines and standardized feature management, reducing training and evaluation turnaround from 5 days to 1.5 days

Investigated retrieval-quality regressions across 30+ enterprise data connectors, identifying index staleness and tokenization inconsistencies through query-level diagnostics and log analysis, restoring measured answer accuracy to 94%
Accelerated search inference performance through INT8 model quantization, request batching, and embedding caching, reducing p95 query latency by 40%, from 820 ms to 490 ms

Tuned RAG retrieval and generation configurations across a 1,500-question evaluation benchmark, experimenting with document chunk sizes, reranking, and citation-grounded prompting to reduce hallucinated responses by 27%
Constructed a retail demand-forecasting model using XGBoost and Prophet ensembles, engineering 60+ predictive features and improving forecast accuracy by reducing MAPE from 18% to 14%

Integrated an NLP-based service ticket classifier with the client's operational platform using FastAPI and Docker on Azure, automating 70% of ticket routing and saving approximately 1,200 agent hours quarterly
Automated weekly operational reporting for 5 business units using Python, SQL, and Airflow pipelines, replacing manual Excel processes and saving 25 analyst hours per week

Formulated a randomized experimentation framework for customer-retention initiatives, defining cohort assignments and statistical significance tests that supported a 6% improvement in retention across 40K customers
Prototyped a hybrid recommendation system combining collaborative and content-based filtering with Python, Pandas, and NumPy, achieving a 12% increase in click-through rates during A/B testing
Trained Random Forest and XGBoost churn prediction models, evaluating 40+ candidate features and performing cross-validated hyperparameter tuning to achieve an AUC of 0.86
Validated a BERT-based document-classification pilot on 10K labeled records, achieving a 91% F1 score through text preprocessing with SpaCy and NLTK and model version tracking in SageMaker
